name: Baleful Shield
body:
School abjuration [force]; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

As shield, but AC applies only against efforts by allies to heal or aid the target.
